system.description:
Activate Reaction

Trigger You achieve a Critical or Heroic saving throw against a possession effect

Frequency 1/minute

The shield's surface becomes briefly reflective, but the face visible within it belongs to whatever attempted to enter the wielder.

The creature or entity responsible for the possession attempt must make a Will saving throw against your Level DC.

Soul Mirror does not reveal an entity that could not otherwise be perceived and does not force an existing possessor out of a host.

Critical: It is unaffected.

Success: It becomes Frightened 1 until the end of its next turn.

Failure: It becomes Frightened 2 and cannot attempt to possess you again for 1 minute.

Fumble: It becomes Frightened 3 and cannot attempt to possess any creature for 1 minute.

Inscribed onto a shield.

On the sheet: Offered automatically, once a minute: after a Critical or Heroic save against a possession-trait effect, the possessor (when the roll knows it) rolls Will against your Level DC — Success: Frightened 1 until the end of its next turn; Failure: Frightened 2 and it cannot possess you for 1 minute; Fumble: Frightened 3 and it cannot possess anyone for 1 minute. Without a known possessor the card asks the GM to roll it.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
